elastic potential energy

thermal energy

the maximum force that the engine can exert
the maximum weight that the engine can lift

questions.questionText:
The properties of two states of matter are listed.
state 1 The molecules move quickly and randomly. There is a large distance between
the molecules.
state 2 The molecules vibrate about fixed positions. The molecules are closely packed
together.
What are states 1 and 2?
state 1 state 2

options.text: gas liquid
liquid solid
solid liquid
gas solid

aluminium

options.text: Cool the aluminium and cool the iron.
Cool the aluminium and heat the iron.

conduction
convection

questions.questionText: Which statement about identical lamps in a parallel circuit is not correct?

options.text: If one lamp blows, the others remain switched on.
The current in each lamp is different.
The lamps can be switched on and off separately.

questions.questionText: Why is a fuse used in an electrical circuit?

options.text: so that the current can have only one value
to prevent the current becoming too large
to provide a path to earth if a fault occurs
to save electrical energy
